en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor subject to cankers (*anāsava*), an unwholesome state subject to cankers arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor subject to cankers, an unwholesome state not subject to cankers arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root; three under object; ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor free from taints (*na-kusala-na-āsava*), an indeterminate state accompanied by taints (*abyākata-sāsava*) arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are five; under predominance [condition] there are five ... [etc. ... under resultant [condition] there are three ... [etc. ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are five.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor free from taints, a wholesome state free from taints (*kusala-anāsava*) arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are six ... [etc. ... under resultant [condition] there are three ... [etc. ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are six.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with the taints (*āsava*), an unwholesome state associated with the taints arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor dissociated from the taints, an unwholesome state dissociated from the taints arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root; three under object (*ārammaṇa*); ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor both-with-outflows-and-not-without-outflows, there arises an unwholesome state that is both with-outflows and accompanied by outflows, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome, nor both-without-outflows-and-not-without-outflows, nor with-outflows, there arises an unwholesome state that is with-outflows but not accompanied by outflows, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are nine; under object [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor an outflow (*anāsava*) and dissociated from the outflows (*āsavavippayutta*), there arises an unwholesome state that is both an outflow and associated with the outflows (*āsavasampayutta*), by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Three for the root condition ... pe ... three for non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome, nor dissociated from the outflows, and not an outflow, there arises an unwholesome state that is both associated with the outflows and not an outflow, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for the root condition ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-unwholesome state that is dissociated from the taints and is itself untainted, there arises an indeterminate state that is dissociated from the taints but is tainted, by way of the root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are five; under the predominance condition there are five ... pe ... under the resultant condition there are three ...
pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are five.
